name: flash
title: Flash
description: A toast notification that slides in at the top of the page, then hides itself after 5 seconds. Hovering or focusing pauses it.

classes.name: flash
classes.description: The notification. Put it on an element with popover="manual".

classes.name: flash--extended
classes.description: Stays visible for 12 seconds instead of 5.

variables.name: --flash-position
variables.description: Distance from the top of the viewport.

variables.name: --flash-size
variables.description: Maximum width on screens 40rem and wider.

attributes.name: data-flash
attributes.description: Shows the popover as soon as the element is on the page, including elements inserted later.

attributes.name: data-flash-action="animationend->hide"
attributes.description: Hides the popover when the CSS animation finishes.

notes: Render the flash from your server after a redirect, or insert it with JavaScript. In these demos a button inserts the markup from a <template>.
